entrypoints.summary: AllocationManager.sol::_slashOperator processes slashing for a pending deallocation.
AllocationManager.sol::modifyAllocations permits a replacement allocation modification when its pending-state guard passes.

affected_components.role: Slashing changes pending state; modification admission and queue consumers expose the ordering defect.

code_slices.fixed: The report says the implemented recommendation changes the pending-modification check to use allocation.effectBlock.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The retained queue entry and replacement effectBlock can leave deallocationQueue unsorted; queue clearing and magnitude calculation consume that state.
code_slices.vulnerable: _slashOperator adds rounded slashedPending to negative allocation.pendingDiff; modifyAllocations admits a request when allocation.pendingDiff equals zero.

relation_candidates.rationale: Rounding can zero the pending-difference sentinel while the earlier queue entry remains, allowing the modification guard to pass.
The replacement modification resets the effect block while the old queue record is retained.
The report states that an unsorted queue causes queue clearing not to clear all deallocations.
The report states that an unsorted queue causes allocatable magnitude to discount deallocations incorrectly.
The recommended and reportedly implemented change bases the pending-modification check on effectBlock rather than pendingDiff.

impact.affected_asset: Operator allocation/deallocation state and calculated allocatable magnitude.
impact.attacker_capability: An operator whose pending deallocation is slashed can submit a new modification after pendingDiff becomes zero, before the original effect block passes.
impact.security_effect: Incorrect lifecycle processing of queued deallocations and incorrect allocatable-magnitude accounting.

causal_trace.summary: An operator has a pending deallocation when slashing is applied.
_slashOperator adds rounded slashedPending to negative allocation.pendingDiff; this can become zero while the old deallocation queue record remains and its effect block has not passed.
modifyAllocations only requires allocation.pendingDiff == 0, accepts a new modification, and resets effectBlock despite the stale queue entry, making deallocationQueue unsorted by effectBlock.
An unsorted queue can cause _clearDeallocationQueue to leave queued deallocations uncleared and getAllocatableMagnitude to discount deallocations incorrectly.

failure.operation: Stale deallocation-queue membership combined with a replacement modification produces entries not sorted by effectBlock.

primary_invariant.statement: A zero pendingDiff must not authorize a new allocation modification while an earlier pending deallocation remains queued before its effectBlock, and queued deallocations must remain ordered by effectBlock.
primary_invariant.violated_because: Slashing can zero pendingDiff without clearing the queue record; the pendingDiff-only gate then permits a new modification that updates effectBlock.

quality.review_notes: The primary audit finding contains code excerpts, a state-transition narrative, recommendation, and reports implementation in PR #1052. No PR, audited source, or test artifact is bundled, so exact patch contents and executable reproducibility are not independently established.

remediation.invariant_restored: modifyAllocations checks pending modifications using allocation.effectBlock rather than solely allocation.pendingDiff, preventing replacement while the prior effect block is pending.

state_context.attacker_state_setup: The operator must have a pending deallocation subjected to slashing while the original effectBlock has not passed.
data_structure_invariants: A pending allocation modification remains nonmodifiable until its effectBlock condition is satisfied.
pendingDiff zero cannot signify absence of pending work while a prior queue record and unpassed effectBlock remain.

numeric_domains.attacker_constraints: A slashed pending deallocation must make the negative pendingDiff become zero.
numeric_domains.name: allocation.pendingDiff
sentinel_values: 0 used by the vulnerable gate as no pending modification

numeric_domains.attacker_constraints: Computed from negative pendingDiff magnitude and a wads-to-slash parameter using mulWadRoundUp.
numeric_domains.name: slashedPending

state_context.state_machine: A pending deallocation is represented by pendingDiff, effectBlock, and a deallocationQueue record. Slashing can alter pendingDiff before the effect block, while a new modification updates effectBlock; queue consumers assume effect-block ordering.
